detailZones.title: Bridge glazing and side walls
detailZones.description: Explore the windows, mullions, sills, seals and side-wall panels along both sides of the bridge.

detailZones.title: Roof and telescoping vestibule
detailZones.description: Inspect the ceiling lights, roof panels and the ribbed flexible vestibule at the aircraft end.

detailZones.title: Bridge controls and emergency phone
detailZones.translation: 廊桥控制装置与应急电话
detailZones.description: Identify the visible joystick console, push buttons, cabinet faces, wall phone and its cord.

detailZones.title: Handrails and boarding threshold
detailZones.description: Follow both continuous handrails, their brackets and the visible raised aircraft-door threshold.

detailZones.title: Floor and boarding route
detailZones.description: Explore the non-slip floor surface, expansion seams, threshold panels and unobstructed boarding path.

detailZones.title: Aircraft door vestibule
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible aircraft doorway, its frame, seals, grab fittings and cabin-side threshold.

anchorAudit.rationale: The source image was inspected at native resolution. The bridge route is unobstructed and shows its handrails, operator console, emergency phone, telescoping vestibule and aircraft threshold. Anchors refer only to visible parts; hidden drive systems and passenger states were excluded.
